oracle_method.arithmetic: Python fractions.Fraction over exact decimal representations of dyadic fixture values
oracle_method.reference: Direct exact evaluation of the declared quadratic objective and primal/KKT witness; does not enumerate solver faces or call its linear algebra
oracle_method.returned_certificate_check: Recomputes the objective gradient from the candidate; checks returned normalized equality rows and multipliers, bound multiplier signs, primal feasibility, and normalized stationarity
oracle_method.strict_convexity: All witness covariance matrices B and R are diagonal positive definite; the exact KKT witness therefore proves the unique global minimizer

mixed_face_witnesses.construction: Deterministic dyadic KKT witnesses with known states, equality and bound multipliers; three face patterns vary active lower, upper, fixed and interior coordinates
mixed_face_witnesses.equality_rows: One equality and an exact redundant duplicate
mixed_face_witnesses.variable_orders: All 24 permutations cycled across the collection
mixed_face_witnesses.unit_scales: Per-coordinate powers of two from 1/8 through 8, cycled deterministically
mixed_face_witnesses.gradient_and_multiplier_values: Deterministic dyadic values; equality and active-bound multipliers include zero and positive values

negative_control.status: Exactly feasible under the duplicate equalities and all bounds, but has nonzero interior stationarity residual and strictly larger exact objective than the certified witness

scope.supports: Independent numerical regression for degenerate equality-plus-bound KKT certification in the manufactured linear H/B/R quadratic estimator
